candidates.title: CARE-MoE: Correlation-Aware Expert Placement and Semantic Equivalence Routing for MoE LLM Inference on Edge Devices
candidates.reason: co-activation correlationとhot/cold driftを用いるexpert placementとsemantic-equivalence routingでedge MoEのload/communicationを同時削減し2.1–5.2倍高速化。

candidates.title: Shared-Prefix KV Reuse Across Standard LoRA Adapters: Quality and Serving Tradeoffs
candidates.reason: 複数LoRA specialistでbase prefill KVを再利用する実serving tradeoffを測定し8Kでwarm-cache TTFT約16倍改善。物理共有されない場合のmemory-saving限界も明示。

candidates.title: FlashGPU-sim: Enabling GPU Modeling for Modern Architectures and AI Workloads
candidates.reason: Triton operatorを直接扱えるmodern GPU cycle-accurate simulatorでasync data movement・tensor core・fine-grained sync等をmodel化。RTX5090/H100/B200の131構成でcycle MAPE 5.24%。

candidates.title: SiliconBench: Speed, Memory, and Fidelity for LLM Serving on Unified-Memory Desktops
candidates.reason: Apple Silicon上9 serving engineを速度・memory・fidelityで比較しQwen3/Qwen3.5/Gemma4、concurrency、Thunderbolt RDMA TPまで評価。local inference基盤比較として直接有用。
